visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with spiky dark hair, wearing a black diving wetsuit with a chest logo, stands on a sunny beach and speaks to someone off-camera. Behind him, turquoise ocean water and small white waves are visible under a clear blue sky. (2) The camera cuts to KID, wearing a black sleeveless shirt, sunglasses, and a multi-colored mesh cap, holding a white sketchbook and a black marker while standing on the same beach. (3) KID speaks confidently while gesturing with his hands, then looks down at his sketchbook to begin drawing. (4) A close-up shot shows the sketchbook as KID's hand draws the outline of a sika deer with large antlers using a black marker. (5) KID holds up the sketchbook to the first man; the first man smiles and identifies the drawing. (6) KID begins a second drawing, and a close-up reveals a sketch of two circular shapes with segmented patterns representing a horseshoe crab. (7) The first man points excitedly and shouts his guess while KID reacts with a celebratory pose, pointing back at him. (8) KID draws a third figure in the sketchbook, showing a round-bodied animal with two small ears and a tail. (9) The first man points and guesses 'A-Zheng'; the camera reveals a woman wearing sunglasses and a wetsuit laughing as a cartoon hippo graphic is overlaid on the screen next to her.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A calm male voice explains the importance of drawing dive routes. The background music is upbeat and playful. (2) A second, more energetic male voice (KID) begins speaking with high pitch variability, expressing confidence in his drawing skills. (3) A fast 'ding' sound effect triggers as the drawing session starts. (4) KID shouts excitedly while describing the drawing. (5) The first man shouts 'Meihualu' (Sika deer) with high arousal, followed immediately by a celebratory cheering and applause SFX. (6) KID speaks rapidly, introducing the next challenge. The background music maintains a constant high tempo. (7) The first man guesses 'Hou' (Horseshoe crab) with high volume and excitement; a loud 'correct' chime and cheering SFX play. (8) KID's voice reaches peak arousal as he draws the final animal. (9) The man guesses 'A-Zheng'; explosive laughter and a comedic 'wah-wah' style horn sound effect play, followed by lively conversation and female laughter as the segment concludes.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Challenge Round 1 -> Challenge Round 2 -> Challenge Round 3 -> Punchline
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic highlight from a variety show where the host, KID, demonstrates his rudimentary drawing skills by sketching local wildlife for a dive coach to guess. The intent is to entertain through the humorous interactions, the surprising accuracy of the guesses despite the crude sketches, and the final reveal of a staff member's nickname.
